package io.github.xyz1001.pdsync.android;

import static pdsync.i18n.AndroidHostMessages.*;
import static pdsync.i18n.PrepareMessages.*;

import java.util.function.Consumer;

/** Host-only ports; production declarations are inserted at the marker below. */
public final class MainActivity {
    enum SyncPage { HOME, CONNECTION, SETTINGS, CONFIRM, CONFLICT }
    enum OnboardingProgress { COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE }
    enum OnboardingKind { READY, BLOCKED, BRANCHED }
    enum DiagnosticAction { PUSH, RESTORE }
    enum SharedHomeOperation { NONE }
    enum SharedHomeStatusKind { RUNNING, CONFLICT, WARNING, SYNCED, NEUTRAL, EXPIRED }
    interface Task { Object run() throws Exception; }
    interface SharedHomeActions {
        void appreciate(); void settings(); void refreshHistory(); void upload(); void restore(); void launch();
        void selectSnapshot(String id); void rename(String id); void changeHistoryPage(int page);
    }
    static final class AndroidSyncFacade {
        static final class Inspection {
            boolean pending;
            boolean isRetryablePending() { return pending; }
            boolean isObjectVerified() { return true; }
        }
        static final class OperationResult { }
        int uploads;
        OperationResult upload(Inspection observed) { uploads++; return new OperationResult(); }
    }
    static final class SyncHistory {
        // Already-computed outputs of the separately tested shared policies, not archive inference.
        final boolean uploadSource, restoreSource;
        boolean uploadUnnecessary, restoreUnnecessary, matchesCloudTip, protectedLocal = true;
        SyncHistory(boolean upload, boolean restore) { uploadSource = upload; restoreSource = restore; }
        boolean getCurrentProtected() { return protectedLocal; }
        java.util.List<AppendCommit> getCloud() { return restoreSource ? java.util.List.of(new AppendCommit("cloud-snapshot"), new AppendCommit("different-history")) : java.util.List.of(); }
        java.util.Map<String,String> getCurrentFiles() { return java.util.Map.of(); }
        int getLocalNodeCount() { return uploadSource ? 1 : 0; }
    }
    static final class AppendCommit {
        final Snapshot snapshot;
        AppendCommit(String id) { snapshot = new Snapshot(id); }
        Snapshot getSnapshot() { return snapshot; }
    }
    static final class Snapshot {
        final String id; Snapshot(String id) { this.id = id; }
        String getId() { return id; }
        java.util.Map<String,String> getFiles() { return java.util.Map.of(); }
    }
    static final class SharedHomeArchiveAvailability {
        final boolean upload, restore;
        SharedHomeArchiveAvailability(boolean up, boolean down) { upload = up; restore = down; }
        boolean getUploadSourceAvailable() { return upload; }
        boolean getRestoreSourceAvailable() { return restore; }
        static SharedHomeArchiveAvailability from(SyncHistory h, String selected, boolean verified) {
            return new SharedHomeArchiveAvailability(verified && h != null && h.uploadSource,
                    verified && h != null && h.restoreSource);
        }
    }
    static final class SharedHomeContent {
        final boolean upload, restore, matchesCloudTip;
        SharedHomeContent(boolean up, boolean down, boolean matches) {
            upload = up; restore = down; matchesCloudTip = matches;
        }
        boolean getUploadUnnecessary() { return upload; }
        boolean getRestoreUnnecessary() { return restore; }
        boolean getMatchesCloudTip() { return matchesCloudTip; }
        static SharedHomeContent fromHome(SyncHistory h, String selected, boolean verified, boolean pending, boolean conflict) {
            SharedHomeContent content = from(h, selected, verified, pending, conflict);
            return new SharedHomeContent(content.upload || content.matchesCloudTip,
                    content.restore || content.matchesCloudTip && !"different-history".equals(selected), content.matchesCloudTip);
        }
        static SharedHomeContent from(SyncHistory h, String selected, boolean verified, boolean pending, boolean conflict) {
            return new SharedHomeContent(verified && h != null && h.uploadUnnecessary,
                    verified && h != null && h.restoreUnnecessary,
                    verified && h != null && !pending && !conflict && h.matchesCloudTip);
        }
    }
    static final class Readiness { boolean ready = true; boolean canContinue() { return ready; } }
    static final class AutomaticHistory { boolean inFlight; Object ticket, connection; }
    static final class SharedHistoryNamingController { void close() {} }
    static final class HistoryPresentation {
        static HistoryPresentation from(SyncHistory h, int page) { return new HistoryPresentation(); }
        int getPages() { return 1; } int getPage() { return 0; }
    }
    static final class LinearLayout {
        static final class LayoutParams { LayoutParams(int w, int h) {} }
        void removeAllViews() {} void setPadding(int a, int b, int c, int d) {}
        void setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(Object listener) {} void addView(Object v, LayoutParams lp) {}
    }
    static final class SharedConfirmationState { final Object[] args; SharedConfirmationState(Object... args) { this.args = args; } }
    static final class AndroidOnboardingComposition {
        static void showHome(MainActivity a, SyncHistory history, int historyPage, Object identity,
                String status, SharedHomeStatusKind statusKind, boolean foreground, boolean busy, boolean upload, boolean restore,
                boolean launch, SharedHomeOperation operation, boolean loading, String selected,
                String explicitSelection, SharedHomeContent content, String notice, boolean error,
                String details, SharedHomeActions actions, SharedHistoryNamingController naming, boolean canAppreciate, boolean canRefreshHistory) {
            a.renderedUpload = upload; a.renderedRestore = restore; a.renderedRefresh = canRefreshHistory; a.homeActions = actions;
            a.renderedStatus = status; a.renderedKind = statusKind; a.renderedAppreciate = canAppreciate; a.renderedNotice = notice;
        }
    }
    static final class AndroidHomeDialogComposition {
        static Object confirmationView(MainActivity a, SharedConfirmationState state, SyncHistory history,
                int historyPage, Object identity, String status, SharedHomeStatusKind statusKind, String explicit, Object backdrop,
                Runnable confirm, Runnable cancel) {
            a.confirmClick = confirm; a.cancelClick = cancel;
            a.renderedConfirmationTitle = (String) state.args[1];
            a.renderedSecondaryLabel = (String) state.args[5];
            return new Object();
        }
    }
    static final class SyncRuntime {
        static Object account;
        static Object currentConnection() { return account; }
        static String currentSelectionToken(MainActivity a) throws Exception {
            if (a.scopeUnavailable) throw new Exception("Synthetic unavailable scope");
            return a.selectionToken;
        }
        static String currentNamespace(MainActivity a) { return a.namespace; }
        static boolean isAutoUploadPaused(MainActivity a) { return false; }
    }

    static final class Installer { boolean active; boolean hasActiveRequest() { return active; } }
    final Installer installer = new Installer();
    boolean expired, official = true, renderedAppreciate;
    int appreciations;
    String renderedStatus, renderedNotice;
    SharedHomeStatusKind renderedKind;
    // Authenticated cache policy is executed separately by TrustedEntitlementCacheChecks.
    boolean homeAccountExpired() { return expired && official && connection != null; }
    boolean accountFresh = true;
    boolean homeAccountAccessAvailable() { return !official || (accountFresh && !expired); }
    boolean isOfficialAccount(Object account) { return official && account != null; }
    void showManagedAccount(Object account) { appreciations++; sharedAppreciationOnly = true; }
    Object connection = new Object();
    AndroidSyncFacade facade = new AndroidSyncFacade();
    AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection inspection = new AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection();
    SyncHistory history;
    HomeActionContext homeObservationOwner;
    final HomeArchiveReadState archiveReads = new HomeArchiveReadState();
    final AutomaticHistory automaticHistoryState = new AutomaticHistory();
    final Readiness readinessState = new Readiness();
    SyncPage page = SyncPage.HOME, renderedPage, confirmationReturn;
    OnboardingProgress progress = OnboardingProgress.COMPLETE;
    OnboardingKind observedKind = OnboardingKind.READY;
    boolean cloudVerified = true, resumed = true, destroyed, busy, sharedAppreciationOnly;
    boolean restoreAllowed = true, saveAccess = true, recovery, scopeUnavailable, onboardingActive;
    boolean confirmationDestructive;
    boolean feedbackError, renderedUpload, renderedRestore, renderedRefresh;
    String restoredSnapshot; boolean replacedLocal;
    String selected = "cloud-snapshot", explicitHomeSelection, gamePackage = "isolated.game";
    String selectionToken = "embedded:isolated.game", namespace = "test-only";
    String notice = "", confirmationTitle, confirmationText, confirmationButton;
    int historyPage, sharedHomeRenderToken, settingsConfirmationToken;
    int operations, restores, refreshes, manualRefreshes, navigations, renders, confirmations;
    LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout();
    Object status, body, footer, scroll, confirmationSettingsBackdrop;
    SharedHistoryNamingController homeNaming;
    SharedHomeActions homeActions;
    Runnable confirmedAction, confirmationMerge, confirmClick, cancelClick;
    String renderedConfirmationTitle, renderedSecondaryLabel;

    boolean isDestroyed() { return destroyed; }
    boolean readyForSaves() { return readinessState.ready; }
    boolean canRequestSaveAccess() { return saveAccess; }
    boolean restoreSupported() { return restoreAllowed; }
    boolean restoreNeedsAttention() { return recovery; }
    boolean automaticObservationSupported() { return true; }
    boolean currentAutomaticHistory(Object t, Object c) { return automaticHistoryState.connection == connection; }
    boolean allowRestoreAction() { return restoreAllowed; }
    String selectedGamePackage() { return gamePackage; }
    Object selectedGameIdentity() { return gamePackage; }
    String automaticStatusBrief() { return ""; }
    String visibleNotice() { return notice; }
    String selectedName() { return "synthetic cloud save"; }
    OnboardingKind kind() { return observedKind; }
    SharedHomeOperation homeOperation() { return SharedHomeOperation.NONE; }
    void launchGame() {} void rename(String id) {} void previewMerge() {}
    void recordHomeRestoreSelection() { } // Diagnostic I/O is tested separately; host selection stays unchanged.
    void render() { renders++; }
    void navigate(SyncPage target) { navigations++; page = target; }
    void refreshComparison(SyncPage target) { refreshes++; }
    void refreshHomeHistory() { if (canRefreshHomeHistory()) manualRefreshes++; }
    AndroidSyncFacade sync() { return facade; }
    void requireRestoreSupport() { if (!restoreAllowed) throw new AssertionError("Unsupported restore reached I/O"); }
    AndroidSyncFacade.OperationResult restoreForCurrentAccount(AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection observed,
            String snapshot, boolean replace) {
        restores++; restoredSnapshot = snapshot; replacedLocal = replace; return new AndroidSyncFacade.OperationResult();
    }
    void operation(DiagnosticAction action, String label, Task work, String success) {
        operations++;
        try { work.run(); } catch (Exception failure) { throw new AssertionError(failure); }
    }
    void showConfirmation(String title, String text, String button, Runnable action) {
        confirmations++; confirmationReturn = page; page = SyncPage.CONFIRM;
        confirmationTitle = title; confirmationText = text; confirmationButton = button;
        confirmedAction = action; settingsConfirmationToken++;
        root = new LinearLayout();
    }
    void cancelConfirmation() { settingsConfirmationToken++; confirmedAction = null; page = confirmationReturn; }

    void showDestructiveConfirmation(String title, String text, String button, Runnable action) { confirmationDestructive = true; showConfirmation(title, text, button, action); }
    /* PRODUCTION_METHODS */

    static int checks;
    static void check(boolean value, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!value) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }
    static MainActivity fresh(boolean local, boolean remote) {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity();
        SyncRuntime.account = a.connection;
        a.history = new SyncHistory(local, remote);
        a.homeObservationOwner = a.currentHomeContext(0);
        return a;
    }
    static void assertGates(MainActivity a, boolean upload, boolean restore, String label) {
        check(a.canHomeUpload() == upload, label + ": upload enabled");
        check(a.canHomeRestore() == restore, label + ": restore enabled");
        a.renderHome();
        check(a.renderedUpload == upload && a.renderedRestore == restore, label + ": rendered flags differ");
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.refreshes == 0, label + ": rendering must not perform I/O");
    }
    static void assertBlocked(MainActivity a, String label) {
        assertGates(a, false, false, label);
        a.requestUpload();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.refreshes == 0 && a.navigations == 0,
                label + ": direct upload request bypass");
        a.upload();
        check(a.operations == 0, label + ": direct upload bypass");
        a.requestRestore();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.confirmations == 0 && a.refreshes == 0 && a.navigations == 0,
                label + ": direct restore bypass");
        a.homeActions.upload(); a.homeActions.restore();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.confirmations == 0, label + ": retained home callback bypass");
    }
    static void blocked(Consumer<MainActivity> change, String label) {
        MainActivity a = fresh(true, true); change.accept(a); assertBlocked(a, label);
    }
    static void confirmationBlocked(Consumer<MainActivity> change, String label) {
        MainActivity a = fresh(true, true); a.history.protectedLocal = false;
        a.explicitHomeSelection = a.selected;
        a.observedKind = OnboardingKind.BRANCHED;
        a.requestRestore();
        check(a.confirmations == 1 && a.operations == 0, label + ": confirmation must be required");
        a.renderConfirmation(); Runnable oldClick = a.confirmClick;
        change.accept(a); oldClick.run();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.restores == 0, label + ": stale confirmation dispatched");
    }
    static void manualRefreshCallbacks() {
        MainActivity empty = fresh(false, false); empty.renderHome();
        check(empty.renderedRefresh, "empty history must retain refresh button eligibility");
        empty.homeActions.refreshHistory();
        check(empty.manualRefreshes == 1 && empty.operations == 0 && empty.refreshes == 0,
                "fresh empty HOME callback dispatches read-only refresh");
        MainActivity unknown = fresh(false, false); unknown.history = null; unknown.inspection = null;
        unknown.facade = null; unknown.cloudVerified = false; unknown.homeObservationOwner = null;
        unknown.renderHome(); unknown.homeActions.refreshHistory();
        check(unknown.renderedRefresh && unknown.manualRefreshes == 1,
                "missing history and old inspection cannot disable explicit refresh");
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") Consumer<MainActivity>[] changes = new Consumer[] {
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.renderHome(),
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.connection = new Object(),
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.facade = new AndroidSyncFacade(),
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.history = new SyncHistory(false, false),
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.inspection = new AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection(),
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.selectionToken = "root:other.game",
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.namespace = "other-profile",
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.page = SyncPage.SETTINGS,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.resumed = false,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.destroyed = true,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.sharedAppreciationOnly = true,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.busy = true,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.archiveReads.begin(),
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.scopeUnavailable = true
        };
        for (int condition = 0; condition < changes.length; condition++) {
            MainActivity a = fresh(true, true); a.renderHome(); SharedHomeActions old = a.homeActions;
            changes[condition].accept(a); old.refreshHistory();
            check(a.manualRefreshes == 0, "stale refresh callback dispatched: " + condition);
        }
    }

    static void metadataDisplayBoundaries() {
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") Consumer<MainActivity>[] changes = new Consumer[] {
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.cloudVerified = false,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.feedbackError = true,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.connection = new Object(),
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> SyncRuntime.account = new Object(),
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.facade = new AndroidSyncFacade(),
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.inspection = new AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection(),
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.selectionToken = "root:other.game",
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.namespace = "other-profile",
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.homeObservationOwner = null,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.archiveReads.begin(),
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.inspection.pending = true,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.observedKind = OnboardingKind.BRANCHED,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.observedKind = OnboardingKind.BLOCKED,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.recovery = true,
            (Consumer<MainActivity>) a -> a.expired = true
        };
        for (int condition = 0; condition < changes.length; condition++) {
            MainActivity a = fresh(true, true); a.history.matchesCloudTip = true;
            changes[condition].accept(a); a.renderHome();
            check(!a.renderedStatus.startsWith(PROGRESS_SYNCED_LOCAL_AND_CLOUD_SAVES_32.text())
                    && a.renderedKind != SharedHomeStatusKind.SYNCED,
                    "unavailable or changed observation cannot claim synced: " + condition);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        manualRefreshCallbacks();
        metadataDisplayBoundaries();
        assertBlocked(fresh(false, false), "both empty");
        assertGates(fresh(true, false), true, false, "local only");
        assertGates(fresh(false, true), false, true, "cloud only");
        assertGates(fresh(true, true), true, true, "both different");
        blocked(a -> { a.history.uploadUnnecessary = true; a.history.restoreUnnecessary = true; }, "both equal");
        MainActivity metadataMatch = fresh(true, true);
        metadataMatch.history.matchesCloudTip = true; metadataMatch.history.protectedLocal = false;
        assertBlocked(metadataMatch, "metadata identical HOME blocks existing transfer buttons");
        check(metadataMatch.renderedStatus.startsWith(PROGRESS_SYNCED_LOCAL_AND_CLOUD_SAVES_32.text())
                && metadataMatch.renderedKind == SharedHomeStatusKind.SYNCED,
                "metadata content match must display synced independently of object proof");
        check(!metadataMatch.history.protectedLocal && !metadataMatch.history.uploadUnnecessary
                && !metadataMatch.history.restoreUnnecessary && metadataMatch.operations == 0,
                "display match cannot create protection or perform an operation");
        metadataMatch.selected = "different-history";
        assertGates(metadataMatch, false, true, "different historical restore remains available");
        metadataMatch.history.matchesCloudTip = false;
        assertGates(metadataMatch, true, true, "changed local bytes re-enable HOME transfers");
        check(metadataMatch.renderedKind != SharedHomeStatusKind.SYNCED,
                "changed content must clear the matching display");
        blocked(a -> { a.official = true; a.expired = true; }, "expired with local and cloud saves");
        blocked(a -> { a.official = true; a.accountFresh = false; }, "failed refresh with old active and both saves");
        MainActivity renewed = fresh(true, true); renewed.official = true; renewed.expired = true;
        assertGates(renewed, false, false, "before renewal with both saves");
        renewed.expired = false; renewed.accountFresh = true;
        assertGates(renewed, true, true, "fresh renewal with existing capabilities");
        renewed.saveAccess = false;
        assertGates(renewed, false, false, "fresh renewal cannot override device capability");
        blocked(a -> a.busy = true, "busy");
        blocked(a -> a.cloudVerified = false, "unverified");
        blocked(a -> a.archiveReads.begin(), "explicit loading");
        blocked(a -> { a.automaticHistoryState.inFlight = true; a.automaticHistoryState.connection = a.connection; }, "automatic loading");
        blocked(a -> a.gamePackage = null, "no game");
        blocked(a -> a.connection = new Object(), "stale account");
        blocked(a -> SyncRuntime.account = new Object(), "runtime account changed");
        blocked(a -> a.facade = new AndroidSyncFacade(), "stale facade");
        blocked(a -> a.history = new SyncHistory(true, true), "stale history");
        blocked(a -> a.inspection = new AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection(), "stale inspection");
        blocked(a -> a.selectionToken = "root:other.game", "stale backend");
        blocked(a -> a.namespace = "other-profile", "stale namespace");
        blocked(a -> a.scopeUnavailable = true, "unavailable scope");
        blocked(a -> a.homeObservationOwner = null, "missing observation owner");
        blocked(a -> a.connection = null, "no account");
        blocked(a -> a.facade = null, "no facade");
        blocked(a -> a.inspection = null, "no inspection");
        blocked(a -> a.history = null, "no history");
        blocked(a -> a.progress = OnboardingProgress.INCOMPLETE, "setup incomplete");
        blocked(a -> a.readinessState.ready = false, "not ready");
        blocked(a -> a.saveAccess = false, "access denied");
        blocked(a -> a.recovery = true, "restore recovery pending");
        blocked(a -> a.observedKind = OnboardingKind.BLOCKED, "blocked inspection");
        blocked(a -> a.resumed = false, "paused");
        blocked(a -> a.destroyed = true, "destroyed");
        blocked(a -> a.sharedAppreciationOnly = true, "appreciation overlay");

        MainActivity a = fresh(true, true); a.restoreAllowed = false;
        assertGates(a, true, false, "unsupported restore");
        a.requestRestore(); check(a.operations == 0, "unsupported restore request rejected");
        a = fresh(true, true); a.inspection.pending = true;
        assertGates(a, true, false, "pending upload keeps retry upload only");

        a = fresh(true, false); a.requestUpload();
        check(a.operations == 1 && a.facade.uploads == 1 && a.confirmations == 0, "local-only direct upload dispatches once");
        a = fresh(false, true); a.requestRestore();
        check(a.operations == 1 && a.restores == 1, "cloud-only protected restore dispatches once");
        a = fresh(true, true); a.renderHome(); a.homeActions.upload();
        check(a.operations == 1 && a.facade.uploads == 1, "current rendered upload callback dispatches");
        a = fresh(true, true); a.renderHome(); a.homeActions.restore();
        check(a.operations == 1 && a.restores == 1, "current rendered restore callback dispatches");

        a = fresh(true, true); a.renderHome(); SharedHomeActions old = a.homeActions;
        a.renderHome(); old.upload(); old.restore();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.confirmations == 0, "rerendered callbacks cannot dispatch");
        a = fresh(true, true); a.renderHome(); old = a.homeActions;
        a.page = SyncPage.SETTINGS; old.upload(); old.restore(); a.requestUpload(); a.requestRestore();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.confirmations == 0, "navigation rejects home callbacks and direct request entries");

        a = fresh(true, true); a.history.protectedLocal = false; a.requestRestore();
        a.renderConfirmation(); a.confirmClick.run();
        check(a.operations == 1 && a.restores == 1, "valid confirmation restores selected archive");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.selected = "other-snapshot", "confirmation changed selection");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.inspection = new AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection(), "confirmation changed inspection");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.history = new SyncHistory(true, true), "confirmation changed history");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.connection = new Object(), "confirmation changed account");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.facade = new AndroidSyncFacade(), "confirmation changed facade");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.selectionToken = "root:other.game", "confirmation changed backend");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.namespace = "other", "confirmation changed namespace");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.archiveReads.begin(), "confirmation explicit loading");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.cloudVerified = false, "confirmation unverified");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.busy = true, "confirmation busy");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.resumed = false, "confirmation paused");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.destroyed = true, "confirmation destroyed");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.page = SyncPage.HOME, "confirmation navigated");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.settingsConfirmationToken++, "confirmation superseded token");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.confirmedAction = () -> {}, "confirmation replaced action");
        confirmationBlocked(MainActivity::cancelConfirmation, "confirmation canceled");
        a = fresh(true, true); a.expired = true; a.cloudVerified = false;
        a.notice = pdsync.i18n.CoreSessionMessages.SERVICE_EXPIRED.text(); a.renderHome();
        check(a.renderedStatus.startsWith(pdsync.i18n.CoreSessionMessages.SERVICE_EXPIRED.text())
                && a.renderedKind == SharedHomeStatusKind.EXPIRED && a.renderedAppreciate,
                "expired state replaces pending-check status and exposes appreciation");
        check(a.renderedNotice.isEmpty() && !a.renderedUpload && !a.renderedRestore,
                "no duplicate expired notice and sync actions stay disabled");
        a.homeActions.appreciate();
        check(a.appreciations == 1 && a.operations == 0, "appreciation only navigates existing panel");
        a.sharedAppreciationOnly = false; a.notice = ""; a.renderHome();
        check(a.renderedKind == SharedHomeStatusKind.EXPIRED && a.renderedAppreciate,
                "returning from appreciation retains status and action");
        old = a.homeActions; a.expired = false; old.appreciate();
        check(a.appreciations == 1, "renewal rejects stale expired callback");
        a.renderHome(); check(!a.renderedAppreciate && a.renderedKind != SharedHomeStatusKind.EXPIRED,
                "renewal removes expired status and action");
        a = fresh(true, true); a.expired = true; a.renderHome(); old = a.homeActions;
        a.page = SyncPage.SETTINGS; old.appreciate();
        check(a.appreciations == 0, "navigation rejects stale appreciation callback");
        a.page = SyncPage.HOME; a.renderHome(); old = a.homeActions; a.connection = new Object(); old.appreciate();
        check(a.appreciations == 0, "account switch rejects stale appreciation callback");
        // Selected history is a source choice, including a selected sibling tip. Protection
        // of current bytes must not silently remove the overwrite-consent boundary.
        for (boolean protectedLocal : new boolean[] { false, true }) {
            for (OnboardingKind kind : new OnboardingKind[] { OnboardingKind.READY, OnboardingKind.BRANCHED }) {
                a = fresh(true, true); a.history.protectedLocal = protectedLocal; a.observedKind = kind;
                a.selected = "different-history"; a.explicitHomeSelection = a.selected;
                a.requestRestore();
                check(a.page == SyncPage.CONFIRM && a.confirmations == 1 && a.operations == 0,
                        "explicit history always asks once before overwrite");
                a.renderConfirmation();
                check(RESTORE_SAVE_154.text().equals(a.renderedConfirmationTitle) && a.renderedSecondaryLabel == null,
                        "rendered selected restore has overwrite warning without another choice");
                Runnable click = a.confirmClick; click.run(); click.run();
                check(a.operations == 1 && a.restores == 1 && a.replacedLocal && "different-history".equals(a.restoredSnapshot),
                        "explicit history confirms exact target only once");
            }
        }
        a = fresh(true, true); a.explicitHomeSelection = a.selected;
        a.requestRestore(); a.renderConfirmation(); Runnable canceledClick = a.confirmClick;
        a.cancelClick.run(); canceledClick.run();
        check(a.page == SyncPage.HOME && a.operations == 0 && a.restores == 0,
                "rendered cancel preserves local progress and invalidates old confirm");
        a.selected = "different-history"; a.explicitHomeSelection = a.selected;
        a.requestRestore(); a.renderConfirmation(); canceledClick.run();
        check(a.operations == 0, "reopened confirmation rejects old target callback");
        a.confirmClick.run();
        check(a.operations == 1 && "different-history".equals(a.restoredSnapshot),
                "reopened confirmation restores only newly selected target");
        a = fresh(true, true); a.observedKind = OnboardingKind.BRANCHED;
        a.requestRestore();
        check(a.page == SyncPage.HOME && a.confirmations == 0 && a.operations == 0,
                "restore requires explicit selection and never enters cloud overwrite");
        a = fresh(true, true); a.observedKind = OnboardingKind.BRANCHED;
        a.selected = "missing-history"; a.explicitHomeSelection = a.selected; a.requestRestore();
        check(a.page == SyncPage.HOME && a.confirmations == 0 && a.operations == 0,
                "missing explicit history cannot restore or enter cloud overwrite");
        a = fresh(true, true); a.history.matchesCloudTip = true;
        a.selected = "different-history"; a.explicitHomeSelection = a.selected; a.requestRestore();
        check(a.confirmations == 1 && a.operations == 0,
                "samehash HOME fix still permits confirming a different history save");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.expired = true, "confirmation account expired");
        confirmationBlocked(x -> x.restoreAllowed = false, "confirmation restore capability changed");
        System.out.println("home archive action execution passed: " + checks + " checks");
    }
}
